body: The 3392 character `long_desc` line (please <censored> the person who created it) really manages to break nvim. Standard vim handles it fine.
I can't reproduce. Is there a specific edit that causes it? Does it happen when you open with `-u NONE`? Do you have syntax highlighting for this file? Do you have your `.nvimrc` file online?

Can you post your .nvimrc file and see if there is anything in your .nvimlog file. I couldn't reproduce it.

Can you also check to see if you get any weird memory spikes?

@splinterofchaos it doesn't happen with the -u NONE option so it must be some plugin issue.

@crr0004 just have this error in the log

```
2015/04/21 11:47:34 [error @ call_set_error:738] 35172 - msgpack-rpc: Channel was closed by the client

```

Here's my current nvimrc

https://github.com/pacuna/vimrc/blob/master/.nvimrc

Thanks.

Ok. I take it back. With `-u NONE` nvim works like expected. Even `syntax on` does not break it with this file. It must be some plugin. Sorry. 

(Standard vim had no problems even with all plugins enabled, just for the record)
@pacuna Have you tried disabling your plugins and seeing if it happens again?
@crr0004 yeah I disabled the plugins and works fine so I think this isn't nvim related. Although in vim I don't have the problem using the same plugin set.
I wouldn't close the issue then, if you can put here the plugins that make neovim crash maybe someone can try to reproduce your bug.
If it's a compatibility problem, it's still interesting for Neovim.. Can you try to isolate which plugin causes it?
@fwalch I think vim-plug is the one causing the problem. I removed all plugins and the problem persisted. Then I commented the lines that load vim-plug and everything was ok

I can reproduce it. It also messes up the terminal (CTRL-C doesn't work anymore, but is printed to the screen).

`.nvimrc`:

``` vim
call plug#begin('~/.vim/plugged')
call plug#end()
```

_Edit:_ I can reproduce it with a88e2f4fd4c3e10aabd41e758cc845332be013da (RelWithDebInfo), but not 84891f2802a0db1a257580f341d70a5fdb0f6c75 (Debug). Did you try upgrading?

Recipe to make nvim crash with this file:
1. `nvim -u NONE test.rb`
2. `:syntax on`
3. `:set encoding=utf-8`
4. `i`

The order of `syntax on` and `set encoding=utf-8` do matter. Other way around it seems not to crash, or not so fast.
